verdict.rationale: Community posts say DeepSeek releases open weights that can be downloaded and run locally (~154 GB native-precision Flash weights, 'open-source', distilled R1 variants). That makes self-tuning plausible, but nothing in the pack documents a fine-tuning path, and the API docs describe inference features only. Missing for 10: a hosted fine-tuning API, first-party documentation for fine-tuning the open weights, explicit weights-license terms permitting fine-tuning, and hands-on fine-tuning corroboration.
